# Feature: Django Class Attribute Lint Corrections

## Overview
Resolve the `RUF012` mutable class-attribute diagnostics on application-owned Django model and serializer declarations while preserving Django and DRF metadata behavior.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want Django declarations to satisfy Ruff without changing the task schema or serializer contract.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
None. This feature changes backend model and serializer declarations only.

### Data Model (Mock)
No new data. Preserve the existing `Task` fields, status choices, priority choices, ordering, serializer fields, and read-only fields.

### Simulated Backend
None. Existing REST payloads and validation behavior must remain unchanged.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Update `backend/tasks/models.py` to mark `Task.STATUS_CHOICES`, `Task.PRIORITY_CHOICES`, and `Task.Meta.ordering` as intentional class-level declarations using the Ruff-compatible typing/configuration approach.
2. Update `backend/tasks/serializers.py` so `TaskSerializer.Meta.fields` and `TaskSerializer.Meta.read_only_fields` are explicitly recognized as intentional immutable metadata declarations without changing their values.
3. Keep Django field definitions and serializer validation methods unchanged unless required by the selected Ruff-compatible annotation approach.
4. Run focused Django checks and `backend/env/Scripts/ruff.exe check backend/tasks/models.py backend/tasks/serializers.py`.
5. Verify the API contract with the existing task list/create/update behavior after lint cleanup.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The five `RUF012` diagnostics in `backend/tasks/models.py` and `backend/tasks/serializers.py` are resolved.
- [ ] Status and priority choices, model ordering, serializer field exposure, and read-only timestamps remain unchanged.
- [ ] Django checks pass without migration or model errors.
- [ ] No new Ruff violations are introduced.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: None - this feature is independent within this sprint.
- **External**: None.
